info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Payments Status API provides real-time insights into the status of payment transactions. By utilizing this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information about individual payments, including their processing status and any associated metadata. This service is essential for merchants and financial institutions that require up-to-date tracking of payment operations for reconciliation and reporting purposes. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and payment service providers who need to monitor transaction progress and assist customers effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the payment status for a specific transaction. It returns detailed information about whether the payment was successful, pending, or failed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of payments. It should contain the necessary parameters required to check payment status.

204.description: The request was successfully processed, but there is no content to return.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to payment status. It is expressed as a string.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_204.title: Payment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment status is successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the payment operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the payment operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsStatusResponse_204.description: Schema representing the response for the payment status operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the payment entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the payment entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment entry was created automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing details about the audit of the payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request.
